title: security(app-shell): AiChatPage auto-sends ?handoffPrompt= from the URL as the build agent's first message, so a crafted link makes a signed-in user author (and, with autoPublishAiBuilds, publish) metadata in one click
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a public door** (class a, security). Reported by a dev on objectstack-ai/cloud#2780 (report `6193031668`, `out_of_scope_findings` 2). The client half was read from code; the cloud half was measured live on a local stack. Code re-read by the cloud seat `repo:cloud#1` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

**Priority p1 (security).** Triage may raise it to p0: it is not measured what the build agent can author (for example, access rules), and that decides whether the chain can expose data.

## What happens
`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (same code at objectui `1fb1ced3` and on `main`):
- **L882:** `handoffPrompt = searchParams.get('handoffPrompt')`.
- **L1256–1263:** on the build route (`agentSegment === 'build'`), the page stashes it as the build pane's **pending first message**, and the pane **sends** it with no user action. The URL mirror strips the parameter afterwards.

The parameter exists for an in-app handoff (ADR-0057 P4, the `ask` surface's "Open in Builder →"). But it is read from the URL, so **any link** can supply it:
- **Direct:** a user already signed in to an environment opens `https://<env>/_console/ai/build?handoffPrompt=<text>` from anywhere. The build agent receives `<text>` as that user's first message.
- **Through cloud (staging today):** since objectstack-ai/cloud#2778, `GET https://cloud.objectos.ai/api/v1/cloud/environments/production/sso-open?next=/_console/ai/build?handoffPrompt=<text>` signs a cloud owner into their production environment and lands there. No hostname is needed, so the user does not even need a session in the environment. Cloud's `next` guard is same-site but parameter-agnostic by design. That landing was measured on a local stack.
- **Cloud environments publish AI builds automatically by default:** `features.autoPublishAiBuilds` is true (cloud `objectos-runtime` runtime config). So one click can author **and publish** metadata as the environment owner.

## Wanted
- A URL parameter must never send a message on the user's behalf.
- Carry the in-app handoff by navigation **state** (or a same-origin store), not by the query string. Or, if a URL parameter is kept, make it **prefill only**: it fills the composer, and the user presses send.
- Cover it with a test: a page loaded with `?handoffPrompt=` sends nothing.
- If cloud#2780's prefill seam (`?prompt=`, prefill-only, never sent) is accepted later, it follows the same rule.

## Exposure note
Production cloud was last deployed on 2026-10-12, before cloud#2778, so the cloud-side amplifier is on staging only. The direct path depends only on objectui and is wherever this console is served.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2780 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2778 · ADR-0057.
